copy.captionKo: 자전거 핸들에 걸린 머플러를 빼내며 멋쩍게 웃는 저녁. 카멜과 초콜릿 브라운의 톤온톤.
copy.captionEn: Freeing a scarf caught on the handlebars, with a sheepish grin. Camel over chocolate brown, tone on tone.
copy.captionDe: Den Schal vom Lenker lösen, mit einem verlegenen Grinsen. Kamel über Schokobraun, Ton in Ton.
copy.introKo: 카멜 코트 아래를 초콜릿 브라운 하나로 이어 입으면, 색을 더하지 않아도 가로등 아래에서 따뜻하게 보여요. 안쪽은 모두 같은 갈색 계열로 맞추고 머플러만 밝은 오트밀로 남겨 두세요. 길게 늘어진 끝이 자전거에 잘 걸리는 건 덤이에요.
copy.introEn: Run one chocolate brown all the way under a camel coat and it reads warm under the street lamps without a single extra colour. Keep everything underneath in the same browns and leave only the scarf in light oatmeal. That the long ends love to catch on a bike is part of the charm.
copy.introDe: Zieht sich ein Schokobraun unter dem Kamelmantel durch, wirkt es im Laternenlicht warm, ganz ohne weitere Farbe. Darunter bleibt alles in denselben Brauntönen, nur der Schal darf hell haferbeige sein. Dass die langen Enden gern am Fahrrad hängen bleiben, gehört dazu.
copy.tipKo: 자전거를 탈 땐 긴 머플러 끝을 코트 안으로 넣어 두세요. 바퀴와 핸들에 걸리지 않아요.
copy.tipEn: When you cycle, tuck the long scarf ends inside the coat so they stay clear of the wheels and handlebars.
copy.tipDe: Beim Radfahren die langen Schalenden in den Mantel stecken, dann bleiben sie von Rädern und Lenker fern.
copy.note: Written in Korean from the editorial (the delivery has English descriptions only, no Korean master), then localized to en/de.
